    Graded right almost split families #

    For a nonzero graded-indecomposable module Z (torsion-free grading group) that is not a summand of a free module, the right almost split map of AuslanderReiten/AlmostSplit/RightAlmostSplit.lean built from a graded presentation and a degree-one functional θ has a graded source (isGrSub_pullbackE). Decomposing the source gives a right almost split family whose sources carry graded-indecomposable gradings (grRASFam).

    (μ.proj h) (b • x) = (Γ.proj (h * g⁻¹)) b • x
